comment: Cutaway cut. Sitcom wrapper around The Question. Timed to spoken lines.

lines.text: This is Dr. Chen. He wrote the textbook. He knows this stuff cold.
Then every semester — that one student.
Dr. Chen, RFC 8312 has a two-way handshake. Why don't we cover that?
He had no idea. Forty students. Fourteen tabs.
But this semester, Chen has MeetHint.
Great question, Jessica. Page 8. Supplementary reading.
Dr. Chen, will this be on the final?
That's not in the pack. I'll email the class.
You know what I can't stand? Guessing. If it's not in the file, the card stays empty.
Cite or silence. The meeting just became searchable.
Forty students. Then someone asks the thing that isn't in the lecture.
MeetHint pulls the line from his files. Nothing uploaded.
If it's not in the pack, the card stays empty.
